'''NCWildKarrde Frozen Captives.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[NCWildKarrde]]
* '''Published:''' 10 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber|CC-D-cloudcitycarbonitechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Cloud City Carbonite Chamber NCWild.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Basic Darkside Deck used to capture opponets, freeze em for heavy force loss, use the Bounty's and Vader's Bounty to retrieve heavy force.

== Strategy ==

Starting Location is the Carbon Chamber. The goal is to get one of the Visage of the Emperor's onto the Colo Claw Fish for the 7 destiny draw. The goal is to get the high level characters out and start hacking with the lightsabers. Once hit then We have a prisoner comes into effect and enables me to capture one of the characters that was hit. Then you  carbon freeze em with the destiny draws and cause massive force loss to the opponet. Subsequently if Luke or someone like a Han Solo is captured you utilize Vader's Bounty or the other bounty card, and collect some major force. The Lightsabers will also create some hefty force drain bonuses if you get em out right. The Ugnaughts add to the carbon bonuses, and Ugloste doubles them. This is the design, I welcome all feedback
